name: Soltvadkert (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Soltvadkert: a blue and white shield with a bunch of grapes and the year 1376 within a yellow frame, above a scroll inscribed Soltvadkert.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Soltvadkert arms in a yellow frame
